# FAQ-026 Engineering FAQ #26
Revision: Rev A

Question: What lubricant part number should be used for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02)?
Answer: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-195 for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02). Background: The selection was validated during the machine acceptance and heat treat process qualification to ensure compatibility with the hydraulic seals and the forging environment. Rationale: CFW-LUB-195 was chosen for its viscosity profile and anti-oxidation additives compatible with the press hydraulic system and the nominal service cycle of the press. Application example: When replenishing the hydraulic sump after a planned reservoir change, label the replacement container with CFW-LUB-195 and confirm the received material matches the part number on the purchase order. Records to keep: Maintain batch traceability by recording the lubricant part number CFW-LUB-195, the supplier lot, and the delivery document in the machine lubrication log and the materials traceability file referenced in ECN-2026-044.

Question: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02)?
Answer: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 475 N·m. Background: The clamp geometry and bolt grade were tested to determine the required preload for consistent mandrel retention during radial rolling operations. Rationale: Applying 475 N·m ensures the clamp bolts develop sufficient clamping force without overstressing the bolt material or altering mandrel alignment. Example use: When performing clamp maintenance, set the torque wrench to 475 N·m and apply sequence tightening as described in the maintenance procedure. Records to keep: Enter the performed torque application, operator initials, and any deviation notes into the equipment maintenance record and reference the applicable maintenance instruction in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.

Question: What lubricant part number should be used for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
Answer: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-463 for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01). Background: The shot blast cabinet auxiliary components that require lubrication were evaluated for contamination resistance and film strength in abrasive environments. Rationale: CFW-LUB-463 provides the required protection for bearings and guides exposed to particulate ingress and was approved for this application. Application example: During scheduled preventive maintenance, apply CFW-LUB-463 to the specified lubrication points listed in the shot blast cabinet task sheet and verify that new lubricant is free from particulate contamination before use. Records to keep: Document the lubricant application of CFW-LUB-463 in the shot blast cabinet maintenance log, retain the material certificate, and cross-reference to SOP-P3-L2-05 where blast cabinet handling is addressed.

Question: What is the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03)?
Answer: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min. Background: Coil cooling requirements were established to prevent coil overheating and to maintain electrical and mechanical integrity over the heater duty cycle. Rationale: Maintaining at least 65 L/min ensures sufficient heat removal from the coil assembly under expected operating conditions and reduces the risk of localized thermal degradation. Example monitoring: During heater startup and periodic checks, verify the flow indicator reads at or above the minimum requirement of 65 L/min and investigate any lower reading before proceeding with production. Records to keep: Record flow readings in the induction heater run log, note the measurement method, and retain any corrective action documentation if flow dropped below 65 L/min. Refer to ECN-2026-044 for change history related to cooling requirements.

Question: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01)?
Answer: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m. Background: Clamp bolt sizing and joint characteristics for this mill were characterized to establish a torque that provides reliable mandrel fixation without introducing residual distortion. Rationale: 605 N·m was derived to meet the clamping force target while remaining within the allowable fastener stress limits determined during design review. Example procedure: During clamp reassembly, use a calibrated torque wrench set to 605 N·m and follow the prescribed star tightening sequence from the maintenance checklist. Records to keep: Log the torque application, tool calibration reference, and operator identity in the mill maintenance record; retain torque records for audit and quality control purposes and link them to the relevant procedure in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.

Related documents:
- ECN-2026-044
- MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2
- SOP-P3-L2-05
